span.p:
Canonical main SHA
Owner: Cloud repository owner
职责: 固定精确 source revision/tree
状态: SOURCE

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Build Portable Candidate
Owner: Cloud Candidate owner
职责: 构建 linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 index 与 checksum-bound bundle
状态: SOURCE + BLOCKED
Gap: PRODUCT-RELEASE-01
Next Evidence: hosted current Candidate manifest

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Immutable Candidate Identity
Owner: Cloud Candidate manifest
职责: 绑定 SHA、index digest、child digests、assets、workflow provenance
状态: TARGET/SOURCE；尚无 current 双路径资格

div.style: color: rgb(73, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Local-Docker Clean-host Qualification
Owner: local installer + CP/Fabric/Ledger/Sub2API fixture
职责: create/readback/WebUI/restart/Delete/final absence/zero wallet mutation/Receipt
状态: LOCAL + BLOCKED（历史 runs 非 exact-current 全链）
Gap: LOCAL-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-01（P0）
Next Evidence: exact-current Linux Candidate receipt

职责: 显式 Profile/domain/image、generic admission、normal purchase、owner readback
状态: BLOCKED（旧 Candidate 证据不能提升 current）
Gap: PORTABLE-INSTALL-01、INSTANCE-MEDOPL-01（P0）
Next Evidence: same-Candidate qualification receipt

Output（固定）

历史事实: v0.1.7 RELEASED，但不证明 current main/TKE readiness

职责: Provider Profile、domain、Workspace image、Secrets
状态: BLOCKED
Gap: PORTABLE-INSTALL-01
Next Evidence: 缺失即 fail closed，无 medopl fallback

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Evidence Rule
Owner: Cloud architecture + Release + Instance owners
职责: 限定 Tests/源码/Candidate/Instance/Release 的证据层级
只有同一 immutable identity 可向上提升
生产状态只能由 Instance owner runtime readback 声明
